acceptance_criteria.statement: A canonical COMMENTED line or an APPROVED state from rizzstack-reviewer[bot] at the head is an independent approval.
The same line or APPROVED state from rizzstack-coordinator[bot] is not an approval.
The same line or APPROVED state from the owner login is not an independent approval.
Text naming the reviewer from any other login, no login, or a look-alike login is not an approval.
A later rejection from any login still refuses the reviewer app's approval.

REVIEWER_LOGIN and review_identity_ok live in the shared policy block; the gate and lane blocks are byte-identical and match the hash in tests/fixtures/shared_policy.sha256 (updated once, by GREEN, to the new block).
merge_lane_v5.decide merges a non-slice PR only on a reviewer-app approval.
The lane refuses merge_state_status BEHIND with merge_state_behind; BEHIND is not a mergeable state.

The gate workflow, read by the strict YAML-subset parser (and equal to PyYAML's reading when PyYAML is installed), is exactly: on pull_request_target only (types within opened/synchronize/reopened/edited/ready_for_review); top-level permissions exactly {contents: read}; no job-level permissions; one job gate-authority with only name, runs-on, timeout-minutes, steps; exactly three steps: actions/checkout pinned to a 40-hex sha with ref = base.sha and persist-credentials false; git fetch --no-tags of refs/pull/${PR_NUMBER}/head with PR_NUMBER from env; python3 .github/scripts/lease_tamper.py with only GH_TOKEN or GITHUB_TOKEN = github.token. No ${{ inside run:, no GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_PATH/GITHUB_OUTPUT/secrets., no working-directory/shell/defaults/container/services/if/needs/strategy.

Fourteen must-fail workflow fixtures under tests/fixtures/workflows/ are refused, including GROKCHAT's exact pwn request (flow-style job write scopes, git reset --hard FETCH_HEAD; it passed all five regex tests of 16ff193c) and its block-style variant; the strict parser refuses flow mappings, anchors/aliases, tags, duplicate keys, tabs, YAML 1.1 booleans, folded scalars, documents, escapes and merge keys.
The gate judges a pull_request_target event like a pull request.

review-rerun.yml runs on pull_request_review (types include submitted and dismissed) with permissions exactly {contents: read, actions: write}, no job permissions, one run step with env only from GH_TOKEN/REPO/PR_NUMBER/HEAD_SHA/HEAD_REF and no ${{ in run.

Executed against a fake gh serving GitHub-shaped workflow runs (pull_request_target runs carry the base sha as head_sha), a review re-runs (POST actions/runs/<id>/rerun) the completed gate-authority.yml pull_request_target run for this pull request at its head, whatever its conclusion, so a later rejection turns a green gate red.
Same-named runs from another workflow file or another pull request are never re-run; failed lease-tamper jobs on pull_request runs are still re-run.
decide() counts a gate-authority check only when its app is github-actions and its workflow run is event pull_request_target at path .github/workflows/gate-authority.yml; a proven check merges.

A same-named job from a pull_request workflow, from another workflow file, from another app or a commit status, or with no workflow provenance refuses gate_authority_unproven, even beside a proven run.
collect_facts records each check run's app slug and resolves the gate-authority check's workflow event and path from GET /repos/{repo}/actions/runs?check_suite_id=<id>.
An APPROVE (owner) line from the owner login (mojomast) is an owner attestation.
An APPROVE (owner) line from the coordinator, the reviewer app, any other login, an empty or a missing login is not an attestation (owner_review_missing).
OWNER_LOGIN and owner_identity_ok live in the shared policy block of gate and lane; review_is_approval(owner kind) is true only from the owner login.
The strict independent_review_at_head path also requires the reviewer login.
A carried (base-merge carry-forward) approval counts from the reviewer app and is refused from the coordinator or owner login.
The lane refuses near-miss authors (no [bot], case or whitespace variants), an empty author and a missing author.
MERGE_STATES is exactly ("CLEAN",).
Plain source, docs and a new capability-free test module stay T1 (no reasons).

Subprocess or code-execution capability in an otherwise-T1 path is T3 capability_subprocess: subprocess/pty/ctypes/multiprocessing/importlib imports, from-imports, __import__, os.exec*/spawn*/posix_spawn/system/popen, eval/exec, JS child_process (require, node:, dynamic import, ES import) and new Function; also in a new test module.

Network capability is T3 capability_network: socket, ssl, urllib, http (incl. from http import client, http.server), ftplib, smtplib, asyncio open_connection, fetch, XMLHttpRequest, WebSocket, sendBeacon, node:net.
Dependency manifests and lockfiles are T3 dependency_manifest.
Test infrastructure (fixtures, helpers, __init__) is T3 test_infra.
Nested CI configuration is T3 ci_config.
Auth, validator, sandbox, permission and approval surfaces are T3 auth_surface, including unseen variants (validators/ dirs, sandbox/ dirs, approvals-v2, permissions.py).

Unknown kinds are T3 unknown_kind: shell/PowerShell/.bat/.cmd, binaries, .so/.whl/.pyc, .ipynb, Makefile and extensionless files, executable mode (incl. a pure mode change), symlinks (incl. outside the repo) and submodules (mode 160000).
Every new T3 reason has a gate_drill tier case expecting T3 with that reason, and the drill lock verifies.

assumptions: Existing fixtures changed only to name review logins explicitly (test_lease_tamper review dicts and helper carry user=rizzstack-reviewer[bot]; test_merge_lane_v5 approve()/owner_approve() authors are rizzstack-reviewer[bot]/mojomast). FakeGitHubApi no longer stamps any login. Behaviour-neutral on main (full suite on main: only GateTests::test_pr_state_gates fails, as intended).
The owner login is the repository owner mojomast for all seven user-owned repos.
Owner attestation is a login-checked text line in this slice; signed owner envelopes are preauth-envelope (S2) and wiring them is the named follow-up slice preauth-wiring.
Unverified on live GitHub: that a pull_request_target job's check run is reported on the PR head commit (the lane requires the check at head). A live canary needs the owner's typed yes.
The new T3 reasons apply to otherwise-allowlisted paths; existing exact-reason tier tests are unchanged.
A throwaway GREEN prototype (not committed) passed every test in the repo (406 passed, 3 skipped) and the gate drill (57 cases, 0 unexpected, 0 lock problems).
notes: Owner follow-ups (settings, need the owner's typed yes): add required check gate-authority to the rulesets, pin it with a 'require workflow' rule to the base file, keep strict up-to-date on.
review-rerun.yml runs on pull_request_review with actions: write from the PR's merge ref (pre-existing); isolating it is flagged for S3.
Vendoring: lease_tamper.py, gate-authority.yml and review-rerun.yml need byte-identical copies in workflow (canonical), bundlebees, hyvv, orbitdesktop, orbit-control-plane and uirizz.

observable_behavior: only rizzstack-reviewer[bot] produces an independent approval; only mojomast produces an owner attestation
gate-authority.yml equals the one allowed structure; 14 must-fail fixtures are refused
the lane refuses gate_authority_unproven for any unproven gate-authority check
a review re-runs the base-pinned gate run
new T3 reasons with drill cases
outcome.summary: An independent approval counts only from the authenticated rizzstack-reviewer[bot] login and an owner attestation only from the owner login (mojomast); review text never names identity. The gate-authority workflow is exactly one base-pinned pull_request_target job (checked structurally by a strict YAML-subset parser) that fetches the PR head as objects and runs only the base gate with a contents:read token. The lane counts a gate-authority check only from that workflow's pull_request_target run (app github-actions, path .github/workflows/gate-authority.yml), never from a same-named job or commit status. review-rerun.yml re-runs that gate run after a submitted or dismissed review, whatever its conclusion. The T1 allowlist excludes capability, dependency, test-infra, nested CI, auth surfaces and unknown kinds, each with a drill case. The lane refuses BEHIND.
